text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 14 · 水墨淡彩 · 银杏月影的魔法回廊 · 石青 / 银灰 / 银杏金.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Original fantasy magic-academy moon courtyard rendered in expressive East Asian ink wash and restrained mineral pigments, crescent-shaped stone arch, quiet circular shallow pool and ancient golden ginkgo tree, closed study alcoves, moon silver and azurite blue, atmospheric ink diffusion, no writing or runic text, no figures.
Visual medium: ink wash; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 14 · 水墨淡彩 · 银杏月影的魔法回廊 · 石青 / 银灰 / 银杏金. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading: layered paper sculpture, Chinese ink watercolor, retro travel poster, vintage film or dreamy 3D, as applicable. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout. Preserve original palette and artistic medium. No dimension values or scale bars.
